description: Test suite for the App component of a React-based daily task manager, including tests for rendering, task dependencies, filters, streak indicators, pinning, notes, and attachments functionalities.

methods.name: test('renders app title and category filter')
methods.description: Verifies that the application title and category filter control are rendered correctly.

methods.name: test('dependencies selector available under Advanced')
methods.description: Checks that the dependencies selector appears after revealing advanced options.

methods.name: test('blocked task cannot be completed until dependency done and badge clears after')
methods.description: Ensures that a task with dependencies cannot be completed until dependencies are fulfilled, and that status badges update accordingly.

methods.name: test('renders due filter control and productivity tabs including Timeline')
methods.description: Verifies presence of due date filter and activity tabs.

methods.name: test('shows streak labels in header and Quick Notes present')
methods.description: Checks for streak indicators and quick notes section.

methods.name: test('pin control exists and pinned tasks appear first and notes button exists')
methods.description: Validates pinning functionality, task order, and notes button presence.

methods.name: test('attachments button exists, can open panel, and attachments area renders')
methods.description: Tests the attachments button, attachment panel opening, and presence of attachment area.
